subject: Operational liaisons and escalation lanes for model phase-out
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Operational liaisons and escalation lanes for model phase-out

Team —

As we start moving from planning into execution for the upcoming model phase-out, I want to lock down the operational liaisons, escalation lanes, and the cadence for external comms. Key constraints: a) several Dedicated customers need 30d notice minimum and SLA exception windows, b) we have two major migration waves (pilot and general), and c) we need a single owner for post-cutover rollback decisions.

Please review the attached "phaseout_liaison_matrix.xlsx". I propose the following initial split of responsibilities (open to edits):

- Migration engineering & compatibility shim: karthik_iyer
- Customer comms & templates: laura_bennett
- Runbook / cutover ops & rollback: ben_carter
- Exceptions intake & legal liaison: neha_kapoor

Asks for this week (by EOD Friday):
1) Confirm you can own the lane above or propose alternate owner.
2) For each lane, list one backup and an estimated turnaround for an escalation (5m, 30m, 4h).
3) Laura — please prepare two customer templates: pilot notice and general-deprecation notice (use the docx attached as a starting point).

I will consolidate and draft a short external note for the pilot group before we loop in Acme. If anyone expects blockers (headcount, legal dependency, audit requirement), flag it in your reply.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: phaseout_liaison_matrix.xlsx, customer_comm_templates_v1.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, ben.carter@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Operational liaisons and escalation lanes for model phase-out

Marissa —

Thanks, I can own the compatibility shim and migration engineering lane. Quick clarifying points:
- SLA exceptions: do we have a defined threshold for when an exception is warranted versus requiring a customer to upgrade (e.g., revenue % or active requests)? I need this to scope the compatibility shim effort.
- Dedicated pools: a handful of customers are on pinned images that will require on-prem patching; do we expect infra to accept minor rollforward patches during the pilot window?

For the escalation turnaround: I can cover 30m for triage (daytime) and 4h for full mitigation plan. Backup: Priyom Das (if he’s available).

I also reviewed the runbook and added a short section on cache warmup sequencing — will attach a diff by EOD.

Karthik
Lead, Inference Engineering

On Wed, Dec 1, 2027 at 9:14 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
>
> As we start moving from planning into execution for the upcoming model phase-out, I want to lock down the operational liaisons...

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, procurement@acme.com
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2027 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Operational liaisons and escalation lanes for model phase-out — proposed pilot cadence for Acme

Emily — looping you in with a short summary and a proposed pilot cadence. Below is the internal note Marissa sent; short bullets for Acme (please see attached runbook for details):

- Pilot window (recommended): Jan 9–Jan 13, 2028 — limited to 3 endpoints, low-traffic hours.
- Notice: 30 days (pilot-specific language we will send once you confirm dates).
- Rollback: Immediate rollback available within the pilot window; post-pilot cutover will have a 2-hour rollback decision window.

Next steps for Acme: please confirm a preferred pilot week, any blackout dates in Jan, and the primary technical contact for the migration. Procurement is cc’d for scheduling procurement-level approvals.

Attachment: migration_runbook_v1.pdf

— Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Manager, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Emily Park <emily.park@acme.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 04 Dec 2027 16:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Operational liaisons and escalation lanes for model phase-out — proposed pilot cadence for Acme

Hi Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for the summary and the runbook. A few items from Acme's side:
1) Jan 9–13 is ok, but Jan 11 we have a marketing push and would prefer to avoid heavy traffic on that day. Can we do Jan 10–12 instead?
2) We need the customer template to explicitly call out data residency and logs retention during the pilot. Our security team will escalate otherwise.
3) Procurement — we need confirmation of any cost implications for early rollback support and a short SOW for the pilot window.

If you can send the updated template and a short bulleted SOW by Monday, we’ll route approvals the same week.

—Emily
Emily Park
Head of Integrations, Acme Corp
